national_indicator_definition: The indicator measures the share of households covered by a fixed very high capacity network (VHCN). These networks include fibre to the premises (FTTP) and qualifying cable networks that meet very high capacity technical requirements. Coverage can be monitored for the total area and by type of area.
national_rationale: Access to fast and reliable internet supports digital connectivity, access to public and educational services, business activity and digital infrastructure development. Monitoring coverage provides insight into the availability of advanced communications networks and differences between areas.
national_methodology_characteristics: For Bosnia and Herzegovina, an estimate of 75.0% for 2025 is currently available from the StateGlobe webpage on fibre-optic coverage. The comparability of this estimate with Eurostat’s definition of fixed VHCN coverage, as well as its reference year, has not been independently confirmed.
national_long_objective: No specific quantitative national target has been established for this indicator in Bosnia and Herzegovina. The EU objective for 2030, under which all European households should be covered by a gigabit network, is an EU strategic objective and should not be interpreted as an official national target for Bosnia and Herzegovina.
eu_indicator_definition: The indicator measures the share of households covered by a fixed very high capacity network (VHCN), including FTTP and qualifying DOCSIS 3.1 cable networks. Data can be broken down by type of area.
eu_rationale: Access to very high capacity networks supports the digital transformation, competitiveness and access to digital services, contributing to Sustainable Development Goals 9 and 17.
eu_methodology_characteristics: The EU monitors VHCN coverage and differences between areas. EU digital connectivity objectives aim to ensure gigabit network coverage for households by 2030.
eu_long_objective: By 2030, all EU households should be covered by a gigabit network and all populated areas by 5G.
